title: Certificates of Deposit: interest crediting, interest payout choices and proceeds methods by tier
content:
## Scope

This card covers, for every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line, when accrued interest is credited, which interest dispositions the owner may choose, how maturity or withdrawal proceeds may be paid, and whether money withdrawn during the grace period earns interest for the grace days.

## Definitions

- **Interest crediting** is either *monthly*, meaning on the last calendar day of each month, or *at maturity*.
- **Interest dispositions available** are the choices the owner may make for credited interest: *compound* (interest is added to the certificate), *pay to checking* or *pay to savings*.
- **Proceeds methods** are the ways maturity or withdrawal proceeds may be paid: to a checking account, to a savings account, or by official check.
- **Grace days earn interest if withdrawn** states whether principal withdrawn during the grace period earns interest for the grace days before the withdrawal.

## Settings by tier

| Tier | Interest crediting | Interest dispositions available | Proceeds methods | Grace days earn interest if withdrawn |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | At maturity | Compound only | Checking, savings, official check | No |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | Monthly | Compound, pay to checking, pay to savings | Checking, savings, official check | No |
| 12-Month Certificate | Monthly | Compound, pay to checking, pay to savings | Checking, savings, official check | No |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | Monthly | Compound, pay to checking, pay to savings | Checking, savings, official check | No |
| 36-Month Certificate | Monthly | Compound, pay to checking, pay to savings | Checking, savings, official check | No |
| 60-Month Certificate | Monthly | Compound, pay to checking, pay to savings | Checking, savings, official check | No |

## Points of judgement

**Can the owner of a 6-Month Certificate have interest paid to a checking account each month?**
No, on two counts drawn from this card: the 6-Month Certificate credits interest at maturity rather than monthly, and compound is the only disposition available on that tier.

**Which tiers let interest be paid out rather than compounded?**
The 11-Month No-Penalty, 12-Month, 18-Month Bump-Up, 36-Month and 60-Month Certificates, each of which offers pay to checking and pay to savings alongside compound.

**Can proceeds be paid by official check on every tier?**
Yes. Every tier lists checking, savings and official check as proceeds methods.

**Does money withdrawn during grace earn anything for the grace days?**
No, on every tier the setting is "No".
